content:
Maya R: Hi all  quick benefits/payroll newbie qs. I started last Tuesday (4/8). Is my medical coverage effective immediately or the first of next month? Also my benefits card hasn't arrived  I paid for a prescription and Lyft to the clinic. Can I get reimbursed before my first paycheck?
People Ops: Welcome Maya! :wave: Medical coverage effective date depends on carrier enrollment and your hire date. Usually coverage is effective on your start date if enrollment was completed during onboarding; otherwise it may be 1st of next month. We'll check the carrier confirmation. For the card: we can issue a virtual benefits card for prescriptions; send receipts to benefits@redwood.com.
Ben F: Payroll detail: payroll cutoff for the holiday/pay cycles is Friday 5pm PT before the run. If your hire was submitted before that cutoff you get holiday pay and any off-cycle reimbursements can be arranged. Off-cycle reimbursements typically take 2-4 business days.
Olivia H: For transit/commuter pre-tax, enroll via the commuter portal within 30 days. If you paid out-of-pocket, submit the receipt to finance@redwood.com with subject "Commuter reimbursement - new hire". We can reconcile on the next off-cycle if needed.
Maya R: Thanks everyone  sending receipts now and double-checking my enrollment. Appreciate the fast help :smile:
